title: Job
description: Durable long-running work item (spec 9.5). Transitions are enforced by the job engine (M03), not by this schema. 'params' holds the handler input so interrupted jobs can be requeued; 'attempt' counts runs (1.1). 'idempotency_key' makes resubmission safe (1.3).

params.description: Handler input (JSON object). Must not contain secrets; paths are allowed but never logged.

result.description: Handler output (JSON object), set when the job reaches 'ready' (and on a failed 'import', so per-file errors stay visible). 'probe': MediaProbe (media-asset.schema.json#/$defs/MediaProbe); 'import': ImportResult (import.schema.json); 'relink': RelinkResult; 'check_sources': SourceCheckResult (import.schema.json#/$defs); 'fingerprint': FingerprintResult (fingerprint.schema.json#/$defs). Must not contain secrets.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key (1.3). Submitting the same key again returns this job instead of creating a new one; reusing it for a different request is refused.

attempt.description: 1 for the first run, incremented on each retry or requeue.
